H1.text: Most news publishers (>50%) still do NOT block meta-externalagent days before 30 Oct.
H1.rule: share of determinate news domains NOT FULL_BLOCKing meta-externalagent > 50%

H2.text: Few publishers (<5%) changed their Meta rules after 15 Oct.
H2.rule: share of paired news domains (both endpoints determinate) whose verdict or naming for any META_TOKENS/LEGACY_META bot changed between T1 and the current snapshot < 5% (T0 used if T1 is unavailable)

H3.text: meta-externalads is blocked far less often than meta-externalagent (the ads gap).
H3.rule: meta-externalads FULL_BLOCK share < meta-externalagent FULL_BLOCK share among news domains, with non-overlapping Wilson CIs or an exact McNemar test p < 0.05 on the same domains

H4.text: Publishers block OpenAI/Anthropic/Google training bots more often than Meta's (the Meta gap).
H4.rule: share of news domains FULL_BLOCKing at least one of gptbot, claudebot, google-extended > share FULL_BLOCKing meta-externalagent, exact McNemar p < 0.05

H5.text: A large share (>50%) of Meta-linked publishers are exposed.
H5.rule: share of META_LINKED news domains (E1 or E2 or E2b) that do NOT FULL_BLOCK meta-externalagent > 50%

H6.text: Changes cluster by owner group or platform template (chain-level decisions).
H6.rule: among news domains that changed any Meta rule (same pair as H2), share that share a template cluster or a known owner group with at least one other changed domain > 50%; requires >= 10 changed domains

benchmarks.reference_source: knownagents.com daily scans of the top 1,000 websites (~19%)
